title: Source amazon provider to use airflow.sdk.configuration.conf
body:

This PR migrates the amazon provider to use airflow.sdk.configuration.conf instead of airflow.configuration.conf. This change maintains backward compatibility through the common compat module.

related: [#60000](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/60000)
